Currency.sql: SELECT c.symbol AS id, c.name AS label FROM currency c
Currency.label: label

Subsidiary.sql: SELECT s.id AS id, s.name AS label, s.parent AS parent, c.symbol AS currency FROM subsidiary s LEFT JOIN currency c ON c.id = s.currency
Subsidiary.label: label

Pillar.sql: SELECT d.id AS id, d.name AS label, d.parent AS parent FROM department d
Pillar.label: label

Customer.sql: SELECT c.id AS id, c.companyname AS label FROM customer c
Customer.label: label

ProjectType.sql: SELECT t.id AS id, t.name AS label FROM jobtype t
ProjectType.label: label

ProjectStatus.sql: SELECT DISTINCT j.entitystatus AS id, BUILTIN.DF(j.entitystatus) AS label FROM job j WHERE j.entitystatus IS NOT NULL
ProjectStatus.label: label

WorkCalendar.sql: SELECT w.id AS id, w.name AS label FROM workcalendar w
WorkCalendar.label: label

Account.sql: SELECT a.id AS id, a.acctnumber || ' ' || a.accountsearchdisplayname AS label, CASE WHEN a.acctnumber IN ('5005', '5102', '5010') THEN 'consulting revenue' END AS report_line FROM account a
Account.label: label

Person.sql: SELECT e.id AS id, e.firstname || ' ' || e.lastname AS label, e.subsidiary AS subsidiary, e.department AS pillar, e.supervisor AS manager, e.workcalendar AS calendar FROM employee e
Person.label: label

Project.sql: SELECT j.id AS id, j.entityid || ' ' || j.companyname AS label, j.subsidiary AS subsidiary, j.custentity_f5_prj_pillar AS pillar, j.customer AS customer, c.symbol AS currency, j.jobtype AS type, j.entitystatus AS status, j.custentity_f5_prj_manager AS manager, j.custentity_f5_prj_senior_supplier AS senior_supplier, CASE j.custentity_f5_project_rag WHEN 1 THEN 'Red' WHEN 2 THEN 'Amber' WHEN 3 THEN 'Green' END AS rag, TO_CHAR(j.custentity_f5_next_go_live, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS go_live, j.custentityf5_gone_live AS gone_live, TO_CHAR(j.startdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS start_date, TO_CHAR(COALESCE(j.enddate, j.calculatedenddate), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS end_date, TO_CHAR(j.datecreated, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS created, CASE WHEN j.custentity_f5_project_rag IN (1, 2) OR TO_NUMBER(j.custentity_f5_total_project_budget) - TO_NUMBER(j.custentity_f5_prj_actual_budget_comsumed) < 0 THEN 'T' ELSE 'F' END AS at_risk FROM job j LEFT JOIN currency c ON c.id = j.currency
Project.label: label

TimeDay.sql: SELECT tb.employee AS person_id, COALESCE(ch.billto, tb.customer) AS project_id, tb.trandate AS day, COALESCE(TO_CHAR(tb.approvalstatus), '0') AS approval, COALESCE(tb.isbillable, 'F') AS billable, tb.timetype AS time_type, COALESCE(ch.cur, jc.symbol) AS currency, SUM(TO_NUMBER(tb.hours)) AS hours, SUM(CASE WHEN tb.isbillable = 'T' AND tb.timetype = 'A' THEN TO_NUMBER(tb.hours) * (CASE WHEN jt.name IN ('Milestone Fixed Price', 'Prepayment') THEN COALESCE(TO_NUMBER(j.custentity9), ch.rate) ELSE ch.rate END) END) AS revenue FROM timebill tb LEFT JOIN (SELECT e.timerecord, e.billto, e.rate, e.cur FROM (SELECT c.timerecord, c.billto, TO_NUMBER(c.rate) AS rate, cc.symbol AS cur, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.timerecord ORDER BY c.createddate DESC, c.id DESC) AS rn FROM charge c JOIN timebill t2 ON t2.id = c.timerecord LEFT JOIN currency cc ON cc.id = c.currency WHERE c.timerecord IS NOT NULL AND (c.use = 'Actual' OR c.stage != 'BILLED') AND t2.trandate >= TO_DATE(@span_from, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND t2.trandate < TO_DATE(@span_to, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) e WHERE e.rn = 1) ch ON ch.timerecord = tb.id JOIN job j ON j.id = COALESCE(ch.billto, tb.customer) LEFT JOIN jobtype jt ON jt.id = j.jobtype LEFT JOIN currency jc ON jc.id = j.currency WHERE tb.trandate >= TO_DATE(@span_from, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND tb.trandate < TO_DATE(@span_to, 'YYYY-MM-DD') GROUP BY tb.employee, COALESCE(ch.billto, tb.customer), tb.trandate, COALESCE(TO_CHAR(tb.approvalstatus), '0'), COALESCE(tb.isbillable, 'F'), tb.timetype, COALESCE(ch.cur, jc.symbol)

ProjectState.sql: SELECT j.id AS project_id, TO_NUMBER(j.custentity_f5_total_project_budget) AS total_budget, TO_NUMBER(j.custentity_f5_prj_actual_budget_comsumed) AS consumed, TO_NUMBER(j.custentity_f5_total_project_budget) - COALESCE(TO_NUMBER(j.custentity_f5_prj_actual_budget_comsumed), 0) AS remaining FROM job j

BudgetLine.sql: SELECT b.subsidiary AS subsidiary_id, b.department AS pillar_id, b.account AS account_id, b.category AS category_id, ap.startdate AS month_start, sc.symbol AS currency, SUM(TO_NUMBER(b.amount)) AS budget FROM BudgetLegacy b JOIN accountingperiod ap ON ap.id = b.period LEFT JOIN subsidiary s ON s.id = b.subsidiary LEFT JOIN currency sc ON sc.id = s.currency WHERE ap.isquarter = 'F' AND ap.isyear = 'F' AND ap.isadjust = 'F' AND ap.startdate >= TO_DATE(@span_from, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND ap.startdate < TO_DATE(@span_to, 'YYYY-MM-DD') GROUP BY b.subsidiary, b.department, b.account, b.category, ap.startdate, sc.symbol

ExchangeRate.sql: SELECT tc.symbol AS from_currency, bc.symbol AS to_currency, r.effectivedate AS day, TO_NUMBER(r.exchangerate) AS rate FROM currencyrate r JOIN currency tc ON tc.id = r.transactioncurrency JOIN currency bc ON bc.id = r.basecurrency
